decisions.reason: As a renamed and already established trommel screen with visible prior acceptance, several years of continued portfolio presence, and strong fit with the firm's recycling equipment core, management would remain highly committed and see little reason to withdraw it now.

This multi-model mobile grinder line represents accumulated development and commercialization effort in a strategically important mobile-processing segment, so management would likely continue and interpret any uneven demand as temporary market or ramp-up variation rather than a reason to exit.

Although more specialized in green waste, this mobile grinder line still supports the firm's resource-saving recycling direction and embodies sunk investment and public commitment, making management more inclined to persist than to retreat within the next year.
